post.description:
Streams one reply (`text/event-stream`, events above). Refusals that come before any byte are plain HTTP errors:
404 unknown model, 422 not a chat model or a request the model cannot take (images, tools), 409 engine or model not
installed, a media generation or another reply running.
Tokens of a text, for the context gauge: exact when the model is loaded, else an estimate.
Unloads the chat model (409 while a reply is being generated).

Turns a raw upload into a stored reference: images are re-encoded as PNG (EXIF orientation, transparency
flattened, 4096 px at most), videos are kept and probed; both get a thumbnail. 422 on an unreadable file.
Deletes media files and their thumbnails (names only: no path separators); missing files are not an error.

schema.title: Response Purge Files Engine V1 Media Purge Post

post.description:
Suggests a transcript for a clip (the user can always correct it). 409 with the reason to show when no
transcription model or engine is installed; 500 when the model fails.

Turns an audio file into a cloning reference clip and writes it to the uploads folder. 422 when the clip is
unreadable, shorter than one second or the source is outside the data folder. The source is not removed.
